gloss: date; day (of a scheduled event); number of days

definitions.explanation: The day fixed for something, or the day something happened; common when arranging schedules.

definitions.gloss: number of days; days (as time taken)
definitions.explanation: A stretch of days, as in how many days something takes or how many have passed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{日|ひ}にち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めよう→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。

examples.english: Days have passed since then, and my memory of it has grown vague.

notes:
{日|ひ}にち is the everyday word for the day on which something is arranged to happen; it is heard constantly when people set up meetings, appointments and events.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {日|ひ}にち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧: to decide on a date
- {日|ひ}にち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧: the date works/matches
- {日|ひ}にち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}する→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧: to change the date
- {日|ひ}にち⟦{未定|みてい}→未定：14985_mitei⟧: date undecided (TBD)
- {日|ひ}にち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧: to take days (sense 2)
- {日|ひ}にち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経|た}つ→経つ：09892_tatsu⟧: days pass (sense 2)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{日付|ひづけ}→日付：03706_hizuke⟧: date (as on a document or calendar)
- ⟦{日程|にってい}→日程：04289_nittei⟧: schedule, itinerary
- ⟦{日取|ひど}り→日取り：12952_hidori⟧: the date chosen for an event (more formal)
- ⟦{日数|にっすう}→日数：12953_nissuu⟧: number of days (the counting word for sense 2)

WRITING:
{日|ひ}にち is written with one kanji and kana. Some dictionaries also list {日日|ひにち}, but that spelling is rare; the two kanji 日日 are usually read にちにち or ひび (day after day).
